}}'''Moby-Duck''' is a {{Rare}} item that grants {{stat|Fishing Wisdom}}. After reaching {{Green|30}} bonus {{Stat|Fishing Wisdom}}, it evolves into a '''Moby-Duck: Collector's Edition'''.

== Obtaining ==
'''Moby-Duck''' can be obtained as an {{RMCT|&d&lOUTSTANDING &2&lJUNK &d&lCATCH}} by fishing with a {{Item|Junk Sinker}} applied to a [[Fishing Rod]].

== Usage ==
Upon reaching {{Green|30}} bonus {{Stat|Fishing Wisdom}}, the '''Moby-Duck''' evolves into a '''Moby-Duck: Collector's Edition''' with the following message.

{{Dialogue|&d&lEVOLUTION! &dYour &5Moby-Duck &dhas evolved!}}

A '''Moby-Duck''' gains {{stat|fishing wisdom|0.1}} every hour of the player being online, taking 300 hours to reach the maximum buff of {{stat|fishing wisdom|30}}. {{Aging Items Process}}

Using a '''Moby-Duck: Collector's Edition''' grants {{statname|fishing wisdom|30}}, as well a permanent {{stat|fishing wisdom|+1}}. This can only be done once.

== Trivia ==
*'''Moby-Duck''' is a reference to the popular 1851 novel [[w:Moby-Dick|''Moby-Dick'']].
**Likewise, {{NPCSprite|Captain Baha}} is a reference to a major character in ''Moby-Dick'', Captain Ahab.
*'''Moby-Duck''' is the only [[Aging Item]] whose permanent bonus is only granted once.

== Obtaining ==
A {{Rare}} '''Montezuma Pet''' can be obtained from {{NPCSprite|Sad Jacquelle}} in the {{Zone|Wyld Woods}} after starting their quest and finding the first Montezuma Soul Piece. It is {{Lv|100}} by default.

== Trivia ==
*The '''Montezuma Pet''' gives a base {{Stat|Rift Time|10}}, but the minimum amount the player can get from it is {{Stat|Rift Time|25}}, due to the {{AN|Nine Lives}} ability and needing at least one soul piece to obtain the pet.
*The '''Montezuma Pet''' cannot be transferred out of the Rift and does not contribute to the player's [[Pet Score]].
*If the player somehow manages to get a {{Item|Tier Boost}} into the Rift, it is possible to apply it to the '''Montezuma Pet''', and it will become {{Level|96}} {{Legendary}}. It does not gain any additional stats or perks.
**The SkyBlock Menu still shows the pet as {{Level|100}} {{Epic}}, and it will be reverted to such when the player leaves and rejoins the Rift.
*The '''Montezuma Pet''' appears to be a reference to the book ''[[w:The Nine Lives of Montezuma|The Nine Lives of Montezuma]]'', which is about a cat named Montezuma, hence the '''Montezuma Pet''' also being a cat.

{{Infobox/Item |type = Consumable item |rarity = rare |collection = Mushroom 7 |lore = Consuming this Magical Mushroom Soup on your private island allows the player to fly for {{Green|200 minutes}}. Leaving the private island will pause the effect! |sell = 640 |bazaar = Mystical Mushroom Soup |raw_materials = 3 Planks *160 Red Mushroom *160 Brown Mushroom *160 Redstone *160 Glowstone Dust |mat_cost_bazaar = *1x Dark Oak Wood *1x Enchanted Red Mushroom *1x Enchanted Brown Mushroom *1x Enchanted Redstone Dust *1x Enchanted Glowstone Dust |auctionable = n |upgrades_from = Magical Mushroom Soup |id = SUPER_MAGIC_MUSHROOM_SOUP }} '''Mystical Mushroom Soup''' is a {{Rare}} consumable unlocked in {{CollectionLink|Mushroom 7}} that allows players to fly on [[Private Island]]s. == Usage == When consumed, '''Mystical Mushroom Soup''' gives the player 200 minutes of flight on private islands. It also makes them invulnerable to fall damage while on their private island, which is useful when building farms. This soup can be a cheaper flight substitute for players without a [[Booster Cookie]]. However, the flight duration is limited and one should be aware if it is about to run out and drink more preemptively, or else you will fall and take damage or possibly die. The flight duration can be extended by consuming additional soup. Mystical Mushroom Soup's duration will pause when leaving the island, resuming when one returns. Warning messages will trigger when there are 60, 30, 10, 5, 4, 3, 2, and 1 second(s) left and when the effect runs out. == Obtaining == Mystical Mushroom Soup can be obtained through crafting. === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Mushroom 7}} |A1 = |B1 = Enchanted Glowstone Dust |C1 = |A2 = Enchanted Red Mushroom |B2 = Enchanted Brown Mushroom |C2 = Enchanted Redstone Dust |A3 = |B3 = Bowl |C3 = |Output = Mystical Mushroom Soup }} }} == Game Message == {| class="wikitable" ! Condition ! Random Message |- |rowspan="3" class="ct" |Consuming |{{Dialogue| &e&oHmm... tasty! &aYou can now fly for &c200 &aminutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oI feel like I can fly! &aYou can now fly for &c200 &aminutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oWhat was in that soup? &aYou can now fly for &c200 &aminutes. }} |- |rowspan="3" class="ct" |Consuming when
already active |{{Dialogue| &e&oHmm... tasty! &aYour flight has been extended for &c200 &aextra minutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oI feel like I can fly! &aYour flight has been extended for &c200 &aextra minutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oWhat was in that soup? &aYour flight has been extended for &c200 &aextra minutes. }} |- |class="ct" |Effect about to expire |{{Dialogue|&cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e10s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e5s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e4s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e3s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e2s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e1s &cMushroom Soup Flight has expired!}} |} == Trivia == * This was announced by a former {{RN|a|Dctr}}, on June 4th, 2020. * Although it requires 160 times as many resources as [[Magical Mushroom Soup]], it lasts 100 times as long, making it a less efficient use of resources. * It was previously known as "Super Magical Mushroom Soup". * The max flight duration is about 596,523 hours, or 2,147,483,647 seconds, which is the 32-bit signed integer limit. This amount of soup would cost {{BZC|*33555 Oak Wood *178957 Enchanted Redstone Dust *178957 Enchanted Glowstone Dust *178957 Enchanted Brown Mushroom *178957 Enchanted Red Mushroom}}.  ** This record was discovered and reached by Cekofari. Upon reaching this limit, the flight duration timer disappears, flying gets disabled, and eating additional soup does not re-enable flight. The only known way to regain flight on the private island is to eat a booster cookie. *The first record was held by Zylenox, who had gotten 520,000 hours of flight, which he explained would last until he died in real lifehttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6oatMZva0jU&t=85s. **The next record was held by MaybeMoshi who beat Zylenox's record with 521,001 hourshttps://hypixel.net/threads/mushroom-soup-record-broken.5342206/. **This record was ultimately broken by Cekofari when he hit the limit of 596,523 hours. * The Mystical Mushroom Soup used to have a different appearance and gave the Nausea effect when consumed. ** The Nausea effect has been removed and Mystical Mushroom Soup was given a different appearance and not considered a Mushroom Soup from vanilla Minecraft. ** The custom Mystical Mushroom Soup was added because the vanilla Mushroom Soup interfered with the mechanics of the soup and caused it to not stack when crafted. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2020/June 4|link=https://hypixel.net/threads/june-4-super-magical-mushroom-soup.2970703/|[[File:Magical Mushroom Soup (old).png|26px]] Added '''Super Magical Mushroom Soup'''.|Renamed item to '''Mystical Mushroom Soup'''.}} {{History|2021/Oct 13|Changed from an actual mushroom soup item to a custom head item, as well as changed texture from [[File:Magical Mushroom Soup (old).png|26px]] to [[File:Mystical Mushroom Soup.png|26px]].|Removed Nausea Effect.}} {{History|0.18.3|Added '''Mystical Mushroom Soup''' to the [[Bazaar]].}} }} == References == == Navigation == {{Nav/Collection/Mushroom}}

The '''Paint Drying Simulator''' is a {{Rare}} item.

== Obtaining ==
A '''Paint Drying Simulator''' can be obtained as a Minor Reward during [[Raffle of the Century]] event, or from the {{Item|Gift Bag of the Century}}.
== Usage ==
A {{Item|Paint Drying Simulator}} can be used to obtain a cumulative {{Stat|Carpentry Wisdom|3.5}} after watching seven colors of paint dry. Each color grants {{Stat|Carpentry Wisdom|0.5}}; each colored tile, displayed with an enchanted stained glass pane, will take between {{Green|500}} and {{Green|2,500}} seconds to fully dry (between {{Green|8.3}} - {{Green|41.7}} minutes), after which it will lose its enchantment glint.

{{:Century Cakes/Countdown}} {{LiveCountdownBox|routine=A[Y600] C[5d 4h -U] L[1]|title=[[File:Complete Century Cake Bundle.png|30px|link=]] Year 600 Raffle of the Century}} {{Infobox/Generic |image=Complete Century Cake Bundle.png |label1=Category|data1=Event}} The '''Raffle of the Century''' is an [[Event]] that happens every {{Green|100}} [[SkyBlock Year]]s. == Mechanics == The '''Raffle of the Century''' has {{Green|3}} tiers of raffles known as the {{Raffle|Speed}}, {{Raffle|Daily}} and {{Raffle|Big One}}. The {{Raffle|Speed}} rolls every {{Green|2}} hours, the {{Raffle|Daily}} every {{Green|24}} hours, and {{Raffle|Big One}} at the end of the event. In order to participate in the '''Raffle of the Century''', the player must speak to {{NPCSprite|Rezzus}} in the {{Zone|Village}} to be assigned to one of the following teams: {{Mctxt|9|BLUE|bold=true}}, {{Mctxt|e|YELLOW|bold=true}}, {{Mctxt|a|GREEN|bold=true}}, {{Mctxt|c|RED|bold=true}} or {{Mctxt|d|PINK|bold=true}}. Upon joining a team, the player gains {{Aqua|3 Raffle Tickets}} and a corresponding team [[Emblem]] is applied for the remainder of the event and cannot be removed. After a player is assigned to a team, they can then either speak to the {{NPCSprite|Incredible Raffle Box}}, open the {{NPCSprite|Incredible Raffle Box}} in the [[SkyBlock Menu]], or use {{Code|/century}} or {{Code|/centuryrafflebox}} to see all the rewards, tasks, and current raffles. == Earning Tickets == To enter a raffle, the player must earn {{Aqua|Raffle Tickets}}. {{Aqua|Raffle Tickets}} can be earned through various methods. === Being Online === The player earns {{Green|1}} {{Aqua|Raffle Ticket}} for every {{Green|15}} minutes of being online, totaling {{Green|96}} {{Aqua|Raffle Tickets}} per day. === Raffle Tasks === Every {{Green|2}} hours, players receive an identical list of {{Green|21}} total tasks, with {{Green|7}} of each (easy, medium and hard) difficulty. When players are out of their reach, the warrior can switch to use bows to perform ranged attacks. The warrior can eat {{Item|Golden Apple}}s to regenerate. However, each time one is consumed, the {{Stat|health}} regeneration that it gives will decrease. Like other [[Dungeon Mobs]], it will naturally regenerate {{Stat|health}} if they've not been attacked in a while. == Game Messages == {|class="wikitable" ! Message ! {{Pink|Emits life-scarring aroma!}} |raw_materials = *960 Acacia Log *160 Coal |mat_cost_bazaar = *1 Enchanted Coal *6 Enchanted Acacia Log }} The '''Repelling Candle''' is an {{Uncommon}} item that can be used to prevent [[Mobs]] from spawning on the player's {{zone|Private Island}}. The crafting recipe for this item is unlocked at {{CollectionLink|Acacia Log|VII}}. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Acacia Log VII}} |A1 = |B1 = Enchanted Coal |C1 = |A2 = Enchanted Acacia Log |B2 = Enchanted Acacia Log |C2 = Enchanted Acacia Log |A3 = Enchanted Acacia Log |B3 = Enchanted Acacia Log |C3 = Enchanted Acacia Log |Output = Repelling Candle }} }} == Usage == When the '''Repelling Candle''' is unlocked in the Island Properties menu, [[Mobs|monsters]] can be prevented from spawning on the island. Mobs spawned from minions are unaffected by this item. It is very useful if the player wishes to cull mobs but also leave the island's biome unaltered, as previous solutions would often use a {{Item|Nether Biome Stick}} to make the hostile mobs into {{MobSprite|Chicken}}s. == Interface == {{/UI}} == Chat Messages == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Message |- |class="ct" | Placed on {{Zone|The Garden}} |{{Dialogue|&cYou can't place that here! Everyone is friendly!}} |} == Gallery == Repelling Candle Render.png|A placed '''Repelling Candle''' Repelling Candle Minikloon.png|As seen when placed by {{RN|a|rank=false|size=10|Minikloon}} Repelling Candle in the Hub.png|A Repelling Candle placed in the Hub === Colors === Red Repelling Candle.png|Red Orange Repelling Candle.png|Orange Yellow Repelling Candle.png|Yellow Green Repelling Candle.png|Green Blue Repelling Candle.png|Blue Purple Repelling Candle.png|Purple Black Repelling Candle.png|Black Pink Repelling Candle.png|Pink Lilac Repelling Candle.png|Lilac Aqua Repelling Candle.png|Aqua Cyan Repelling Candle.png|Cyan Brown Repelling Candle.png|Brown Gray Repelling Candle.png|Gray White Repelling Candle.png|White == Trivia == *There appears to be a {{red|Red}} Repelling Candle in {{zone|Catacombs Entrance}} in the {{zone|Coal Mine}}. *There is a bug where the Repelling Candle is able to be placed in the Hub. |-
| class="ct" |First interaction during [[Raffle of the Century]]
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Hey there! Happy &bSkyBlock Year [year]&f!

|-
| class="ct" |Joining a team
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Sweet, the &l[COLOR] &fteam.

&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Anyway... there are &63 &fkinds of raffles going on.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: &6Speed Raffles &fare drawn every &92 &fhours.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: &bDaily Raffles&f, they happen every &624 &fhours.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: &c&lThe Big One&f, which is going to be drawn at the end of &bYear [year]&f!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: To participate, collect &bRaffle Tickets &fand &dslices of cake &fby simply playing &aSkyBlock &fduring the event.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: All tickets you gain are automatically entered into the next raffle of each type.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: When you receive a &dslice of cake&f, it will be a certain &cc&6o&el&ao&9r&f, which corresponds to a certain team.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: There are slices of &cRed Velvet&f, &9Blueberry&f, &eLemon Cheesecake&f, &aMatcha&f, and &dStrawberry Shortcake&f!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: If you take your slice of cake and feed it to a member of that team, you'll both get some &6rewards&f, in addition to &9bonus Raffle Tickets&f!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Here, I'll give you &b3 Raffle Tickets &fto get you started.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: You can get more tickets by eating cake and completing &bRaffle Tasks&f. Check out the &6Raffle Box &ffor more info on those!
&6&lREZZUS GIFT! &eYou gained &b+3 Raffle Tickets&e!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Tada!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: You can click on the &6Raffle Box &fnext to me or in your &aSkyBlock Menu &fto view your event progress.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Oh, one last thing! The team that enters the most tickets into &c&lThe Big One &fwill receive a special &cmemento &fat the end of the event!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Have fun! You can come speak to me again if you have any questions!}}
|-
| class="ct" |Subsequent interactions
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Hello again! &dHappy Century Celebration&f!

|-

&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: You can tell what team someone is by looking at the color of the cake emblem next to their name in chat.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Or, by looking at the color of the cake emblem next to their name in the TAB list.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: If they don't have a cake emblem, then they haven't gotten involved in the event yet...

|-

&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Hi!

The '''Royal Pigeon''' is a {{Legendary}} item.

== Obtaining ==
A '''Royal Pigeon''' can be claimed once the player reaches [[Commissions|Commission Milestone V]], which requires at least {{Green|500}} {{zone|Dwarven Mines}}, {{zone|Crystal Hollows}} or {{zone|Glacite Tunnels}} [[Commissions]] to be completed.

== Usage ==
Every {{Green|5}} seconds, the player can use the '''Royal Pigeon''' to access the [[Commissions#Interface|Commissions menu]] remotely from within the {{zone|Dwarven Mines}}, {{zone|Crystal Hollows}}, {{zone|Glacite Tunnels}} or {{zone|Glacite Mineshafts}}.

{{:Emissary/UI}}

A '''Royal Pigeon''' can be returned to {{NPCSprite|Queen Mismyla}} to obtain her [[Abiphones#Contacts|Abiphone contact]].

== Game Message ==
{| class="wikitable"
!Condition
!Message
|-
| class="ct" | On Cooldown
|{{Dialogue|&cThis ability is on cooldown for #s.}}
|-
| class="ct" | Outside Mining Areas
|{{Dialogue|&cThe Royal Pigeon can't find the King from here.}}
|}

== Tips ==
*It is possible to right click the '''Royal Pigeon''' and then quickly swap to a mining tool with {{Ench|Compact}} before the menu opens to increase your {{Skill|Mining}} XP gain while claiming [[Commissions]].

== Trivia ==
*The '''Royal Pigeon''' is a reference to the fact that [[w:Pigeon_post|carrier pigeons]] have been used as messengers for thousands of years.
*Despite the '''Royal Pigeon'''<nowiki>'</nowiki>s ability being unavailable outside of the {{zone|Dwarven Mines}}, {{zone|Crystal Hollows}}, {{zone|Glacite Tunnels}} and {{zone|Glacite Mineshafts}}, calling {{NPCSprite|Queen Mismyla}} on an [[Abiphone]] will open the [[Commissions#Interface|Commissions menu]] regardless of the player's location.
* Trying to use the '''Royal Pigeon''' outside of the Dwarven Mines would previously display the message, "You may not use this Item outside the Dwarven Caves!".

== Dialogue ==
{| class="wikitable"

|-

|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Royal Resident&f: What are you doing in my room?
&e[NPC] Royal Resident&f: Get out of my room now!
&e[NPC] Royal Resident&f: I am going to call the guards if you don't leave

&e[NPC] Royal Resident&f: Well hmph, I guess the guards are kind of busy right now...

&e[NPC] Royal Resident&f: Wanna hear another one?
&e[NPC] Royal Resident&f: I know you do.
&e[NPC] Royal Resident&f: Why don't mining towns have hospitals?

&e[NPC] Royal Resident&f: Enough jokes for now...

&e[NPC] Royal Resident&f: Yea over there, just outside of the door!

&e[NPC] Royal Resident&f: Tadaa

== Tips ==
*You can hold right click instead of continually clicking the NPC to keep the dialogue going.
** Once he starts counting down, there is no need to click or hold mouse buttons anymore.
** The countdown will continue when you rejoin the Dwarven mines.

== Trivia ==
*The '''Royal Resident''' is one of the few NPCs that break the [[w:Fourth wall|fourth wall]], a term used to describe a character separated from its audience, due to it being in a "different world".  
**This is because it is aware that it's on a server and that servers restart.
*Its countdown takes roughly 25,000 seconds, or around 7 hours to complete.
*Despite the reference to server restarts, the player can leave the lobby anytime after the Royal Resident starts counting down from 5,000 and will continue the countdown when the player returns.
*At line 79 it transforms into a cow, and at line 94 into a sheep, followed by revealing that he has no name at line 130.
*21 lines after becoming "No Name", it will give the player {{Item|The Cake}}.
*{{Item|The Cake}} is a reference to the game ''[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal_(video_game)  Portal]''. 
**It takes around 15–20 minutes to obtain {{Item|The Cake}}.
*"Because of you and those meddling kids..." is a reference to a popular children's show, [[w:Scooby Doo|''Scooby Doo'']].
*At the end of the conversation, the {{ach|Royal Conversation|ach=true}} is rewarded to the player.

Happy Anniversary!}} |} == Usage == {{:Hatcessories/Effect}} ==Trivia== *The expression of the hat was randomly selected when it was claimed, like the color of [[Century Cake]] and [[Crab Hat of Celebration]]. *The Grumpy expression is a reference to Grumpy Cat, a popular meme from the 2010's. * Players could only acquire a Sloth Hat on one [[profile]]. *The Sloth Hats, [[Crab Hat of Celebration|Crab Hats]], and the [[Pulse Ring]] are the only [[Accessory|Accessories]] that give {{stat|mf}} without [[Enrichments]]. *The amount of {{stat|int}} gained depends only on the number of [[Time|SkyBlock years]] that have passed since the player created their oldest profile, regardless of the player's activity during this time. The current maximum, which applies to players who joined during the first SkyBlock year, is {{SkyClock}}. * Despite one of Hypixel's owners being associated with sloths, this is the first Sloth themed item in the game. * [[Hatccessory|Hatccessories]] are inconsistent with their names. The 2022 Crab Hats are the only Hatcessories specifying their year of origin in their title. Crab Hats and Sloth Hats are said to be "of Celebration", while the Balloon Hats are "Anniversary". * Sloth Hats come in 10 variants, while every other [[Hatcessory|Hatcessories]] only has 9. == Gallery ==

{{DISPLAYTITLE:Soulflow}} {{For|the item which grants {{Stat|soulflow|160}} when consumed|Soulflow (Item)}} {{Infobox/Stat |image=Soulflow (currency).png |uses = Abilities of some items, {{Stat|Overflow Mana}} Conversion |ways_to_increase = Consuming Soulflow Items: {{Item|Soulflow (Item)|text=Soulflow}}/{{Item|Raw Soulflow}} |symbol = ⸎ |unicode = U+2E0E }} {{Stat|Soulflow}}, or '''Internalized Soulflow''', is a player resource similar to {{Stat|mana}}. It is used to fuel powerful abilities from the [[Enderman Slayer]] and to generate {{Stat|overflow mana}}. == Obtaining == A player can obtain {{Stat|Soulflow}} by consuming the following Soulflow Items: {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Item ! {{Stat|Soulflow}} Granted |- | {{Slot|Raw Soulflow}} | [[Raw Soulflow]] | 1 |- | {{Slot|Soulflow}} | [[Soulflow (Item)|Soulflow]] | 160 |} A minion will start producing Soulflow Items when equipped with the following Minion Upgrades: {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Item ! Remarks |- | {{Slot|Lesser Soulflow Engine}} | [[Lesser Soulflow Engine]] | Produces {{Red|50% less}}
Produces {{Item|Raw Soulflow}} (Also {{Item|Soulflow (Item)|text=Soulflow}} with {{Item|Super Compactor 3000}}/{{Item|Dwarven Super Compactor}}) |- | {{Slot|Soulflow Engine}} | [[Soulflow Engine]] | Produces {{Red|50% less}}
Produces {{Item|Raw Soulflow}} (Also {{Item|Soulflow (Item)|text=Soulflow}} with {{Item|Super Compactor 3000}}/{{Item|Dwarven Super Compactor}})
{{Green|+3%}} output when used on a {{MinionName|Voidling}} |} By consuming Soulflow Items, a player receives an amount of '''Internalized Soulflow''', which is also signified by the icon [[File:Soulflow (currency).png|13px|link=]]. Once consumed, there is no way to turn the {{Stat|Soulflow}} back into items. There is no known cap for the amount of Internalized {{Stat|Soulflow}} a player can have at once. == Usage == Internalized {{Stat|Soulflow}} is not displayed on the action bar, and can only be viewed on the tooltip of [[Soulflow Pile]] line accessories or in the Profile widget in the [[Tablist Widgets]]. Certain powerful abilities and items use {{Stat|soulflow}}: {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Item ! {{Stat|Soulflow}} Cost |- | {{Slot|Handy Blood Chalice}} | [[Handy Blood Chalice]] | 1 per 5s in combat |- | {{Slot|Pocket Espresso Machine}} | [[Pocket Espresso Machine]] | 1 per 5s in combat |- | {{Slot|Soulflow Pile}} | [[Soulflow Pile]] | Up to 5 when leaving combat |- | {{Slot|Soulflow Battery}} | [[Soulflow Battery]] | Up to 4 when leaving combat |- | {{Slot|Soulflow Supercell}} | [[Soulflow Supercell]] | Up to 4 when leaving combat |- | {{Slot|Etherwarp Conduit}} | [[Etherwarp Conduit]] | 1 |- | {{Slot|Voidedge Katana}} | [[Voidedge Katana]] | 1 |- | {{Slot|Vorpal Katana}} | [[Vorpal Katana]] | 1 |- | {{Slot|Atomsplit Katana}} | [[Atomsplit Katana]] | 2 |- | {{Slot|Final Destination Chestplate}} | [[Final Destination Armor]] | 2 per 5s in combat |- | {{Slot|Gloomlock Grimoire}} | [[Gloomlock Grimoire]] | 15 |- | {{Slot|Gyrokinetic Wand}} | [[Gyrokinetic Wand]] | 10 (Left Click) |- | {{Slot|Gyrokinetic Wand}} | [[Gyrokinetic Wand]] | 2 (Right Click) |- | {{Slot|Soul Esoward}} | [[Soul Esoward]] | 10 |- | {{Slot|Terminator}} | [[Terminator]] | 1 |} If insufficient {{Stat|soulflow}} is available, the abilities will not work. == Game Message == {| class="wikitable" ! Condition ! Game Message |- | class="ct" rowspan="2" | Attempting to use an ability
without sufficient {{Stat|soulflow}} | {{Dialogue|&cNot enough soulflow!}} |- | {{Dialogue|&cnOt EnOuGh SoUlFlOw!}} |} == Trivia == * The symbol for {{Stat|soulflow}}, U+2E0E ⸎ "EDITORIAL CORONIS", is displayed as a lined diamond on some fonts and systems and a square root symbol on other fonts and systems. * The probability to receive the message {{Red|"nOt EnOuGh SoUlFlOw!"}} instead of {{Red|"Not enough soulflow!"}} is {{Chance|2%|1|50}}. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|0.11.5|Added {{Stat|Soulflow}}.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Stats}}

A '''Special Zealot''' is a [[Mob]] that has a chance to spawn when the Player kills a {{MobSprite|Zealot}} or {{MobSprite|Zealot Bruiser}}. 

== Spawning ==
When a Player kills a normal {{MobSprite|Zealot}}, there is a base {{Chance|0.2381%|1|420}} chance for a '''Special Zealot''' to spawn nearby.

When a '''Special Zealot''' spawns, the Player who contributed to its spawn will hear a Wither sound effect and the following chat message:
{{Dialogue|&aA special &5Zealot &ahas spawned nearby!}}

==== Increasing Spawn Chances ====
Multiple factors can increase the chance of a '''Special Zealot''' spawning:
<!--*If the Zealot takes more than 1 hit before dying, the chance of a Special Zealot spawning is increased by about 11.1%.
*After {{Green|420}} Zealots (or {{Green|378}} Zealots if the Zealot took more than 1 hit to kill) are killed without a Special Zealot spawning, the spawn chance doubles. 
*The {{Legendary}} {{Item|Enderman Pet}} at Level 100 will also increase the odds by {{Green|25%}}.
*The [[Essence Shop#Zealuck|Zealuck]] Dragon [[Essence Shop]] perk increases the chance for a Special Zealot to spawn by {{Green|2-10%}}.
*{{Stat|Tracking}} further increases the chance for Special Zealots to spawn (for example, {{Stat|Tracking|5}} is a {{Green|5%}} increase).-->

== Spawning ==
A '''Sphinx''' has a chance to spawn when digging [[Griffin Burrows]] with a {{Legendary}} or higher {{Item|Griffin Pet}} equipped.

== Behavior ==
When spawned, the '''Sphinx''' will ask the player a question in chat. Answering correctly rewards the player with a random piece of [[Griffin_Burrows#Item_Loot|treasure]]. Answering incorrectly results in the '''Sphinx''' becoming {{Red|infuriated}}, increasing its {{Stat|Health}} and {{Stat|Max HP}} by {{Green|50%}}, as well as inflicting a stronger bleeding effect on players.

3 in 100

no

it looks as if it completely overrides the catch}} chance to replace any catch (including [[Sea Creatures]]) with vanilla [[Vanilla Objects/Music Discs|Music Disc]]. It is located in the {{Zone|Hexatorum}} in the [[Hub]]. == Mechanics == '''The Hex''' allows players to insert an item into its menu and examine it. It shows all the upgrades the item currently has and how much further it can be upgraded. It can apply all listed upgrades to the item. To upgrade gear, it can take items from the player's inventory, and [[Storage]]. It can also use the player's {{C}} to buy upgrades from the [[Bazaar]]. '''The Hex''' can be used to remove enchantments, including [[Stacking Enchantments]], [[Endcap Upgrades]], and those applied using [[Enchanted Book]]s rather than the [[Enchantment Table]]. {{Infobox/Item |rarity = e |type = Mutation |tradeable = n |auctionable = n |museum = n |bazaar = THUNDERLING |id = THUNDERLING }} A '''Thunderling''' is an {{Epic}} [[Mutation]]. == Obtaining == A '''Thunderling''' can grow in the [[Greenhouse]] if there are {{Item|Soggybud|amount=5}} and {{Item|Noctilume|amount=3}} within {{Green|1}} block of farmland. While growing, a '''Thunderling''' does not need water and has {{Green|16}} {{Dark Green|Growth Stages}}. When placed near another crop, it spreads buffs and debuffs to adjacent crops. A '''Thunderling''' gains charge as it grows, filling up a progress bar. If a '''Thunderling''' has more than {{Yellow|16000}} charge, it will stop growing until discharged. The player must right-click it to get rid of charge. Additionally, discharging while holding a {{Item|Thunder in a Bottle}}, {{Item|Storm in a Bottle}}, or {{Item|Hurricane in a Bottle}} provides charge, equivalent to the current charge shown in the Growth Status ({{Yellow|2000}} for every growth stage). When harvesting without any of the bottles in hand, the discharge deals {{Green|30%}} of the player's current {{Statname|HP}} as {{Statname|True Damage}} to the player. == Crop Drops == When harvested, '''Thunderlings''' also drop {{Item|Cactus|amount=1650}}, {{Item|Melon Slice|amount=4400}}, {{Item|Wild Rose|amount=4400}}, and {{Skill XP|17600 Farming}}. == Usage == === Crop Analyzer === A '''Thunderling''' can be analyzed in the [[Crop Analyzer]] for {{c|800k}}. When analyzed, it grants {{Copper|400}}. The first time analyzing a '''Thunderling''' grants an additional {{Copper|1,000}}. === Mutations === '''Thunderling''' are used to create a {{Item|PlantBoy Advance}}. == Game Message == {| class="wikitable" |- ! Condition ! Message |- | class="ct" | Discharging with hand | {{Dialogue|&c&lOUCH! &cThe Thunderling has discharged all his energy, frying you!}} |- | class="ct" | Discharging with {{Item|Empty Thunder Bottle}},
{{Item|Empty Storm Bottle}},
or {{Item|Empty Hurricane Bottle}} | {{Dialogue|&6&lZOOP! &eYour &7[item name] &ehas absorbed &6[amount] &echarge, calming your Thunderling.}} |} == Trivia == * Despite dealing {{Green|30%}} of the player's {{Statname|HP}} as {{Statname|True Damage}}, a '''Thunderling's''' discharge can never lead to the player's death, as it deals {{Stat|True Damage}} based on their current {{Stat|HP}} instead of their maximum. == Gallery == File:Thunderling Render.png|'''Thunderling''' in the [[Greenhouse]] == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2025/Dec 5|[[File:Thunderling.png|26px]] Added '''Thunderling'''.}} {{History|2026/Sep 30|Going over max charge no longer destroys the Mutation.}} |beta= {{History|2025/Dec 15|[[File:Thunderling.png|26px]] Added '''Thunderling'''.}} {{History|0.27.2|Going over max charge no longer destroys the Mutation.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Mutations}} [[Category:Mutations]]

{{Outdated| * What does the game consider as a "rare" goblin egg ? * What are the Loot Pools used for Structure Chests ?}} {{Infobox/Generic |title=Treasure Chests |image=Chest.png |label1=Category |data1=[[Mechanics]] |label2=Zone |data2=[[Crystal Hollows]] }} '''Treasure Chests''' are exclusive to the [[Crystal Hollows]]. Either dug or found in structures, they are the main way of gaining {{Gemstone Powder}}. {{For|Chests found using a {{Item|Metal Detector}}|Metal Detector#Drops}} __TOC__ == Treasure Chests == '''Treasure Chests''' exist in {{green|2}} types : '''Dug Chests''' and '''Loot Chests'''. ===Dug Chests=== [[File:Chest.png|21px|link=]] '''Dug Chests''' can be spawned anywhere except near the {{Item|Bedrock|link=}} walls. They have a lifetime of {{green|1}} minute before disappearing. * They are viewable by all players but only lootable by the player who spawned it. * The player must aim at the {{grey|critical}} particles ("{{Blue|Locks}}") on a face of the chest {{green|5}} times in a row to open it. Successfully picking a "{{Blue|Lock}}" plays a sound cue. Their number can be decreased down to {{green|0}}, making the chest instantly openable. * They have a {{Green|Base Chance}} of {{Chance|0.2%|1|500}} to spawn from mining {{Item|Hard Stone}} only. : When a block of {{Item|Hard Stone}} is broken, a random decimal number between {{green|0}} and {{green|100}} excluded is rolled. If that number is smaller than the player's {{Blue|Final Chance}}, then a [[File:Chest.png|21px|link=]] Dug Chest is spawned. :{|class="wikitable" |{{Blue|Final Chance}} = {{Green|Base Chance}} + {{Green|Bonus}}[[File:Emerald.png|17px|link=]][[Great Explorer]] perk + {{Green|Bonus}}{{Item|Scatha Pet}}'s {{AN|Burrowing}} perk | |} :{|class="wikitable" | !Effect !Type of Source !Source |- !Decreasing "{{Blue|Locks}}" |{{green|-1}}→{{green|-5}}The fifth and final lock is removed at Level {{green|20}}. With a {{Item|Blue Cheese Goblin Omelette}}, this can be achieved at Level {{green|19}}. |{{HotM|small=y}} perk |[[File:Emerald.png|21px|link=]][[Great Explorer]] |- !rowspan="4"|Increasing {{Blue|Final Chance}} |{{green|+20%}}→{{green|100%}} |{{HotM|small=y}} perk |[[File:Emerald.png|21px|link=]][[Great Explorer]] |- |{{green|+0.3%}}→{{green|30%}} |[[Pet]] perk |{{Item|Scatha Pet|rarity=r}}'s {{AN|Burrowing}} |- |{{green|+0.4%}}→{{green|40%}} |[[Pet]] perk |{{Item|Scatha Pet|rarity=e}}'s {{AN|Burrowing}} |- |{{green|+0.5%}}→{{green|50%}} |[[Pet]] perk |{{Item|Scatha Pet|rarity=l}}'s {{AN|Burrowing}} |} :At most, the player has a raw {{Chance|1.7%|1|58.82}} chance of spawning a [[File:Chest.png|21px|link=]] Dug Chest upon breaking a block of {{Item|Hard Stone}}. ===Loot Chests=== [[File:Chest.png|21px|link=]] '''Loot Chests''' can spawn in set locations within structures – provided these spawn. * They are viewable and lootable by all players. * They can be opened directly, with a small time delay. * The loot within a '''Loot Chest''' is always the same for all players who open it within that '''Crystal Hollows''' instance except in the following cases: ** For all of them, the amount of {{Gemstone Powder}} varieshttps://ibb.co/wd0WZkk. ** For the one inside the '''Trapped Sludge''' of the {{Zone|Jungle}}, the loot is entirely rerolled for each player. * A player cannot claim the rewards from the same '''Loot Chest''' on multiple profiles. ====Jungle Temple Exception==== {{See also|Jungle Temple}} Its {{green|2}} '''Loot Chests''' function differently: * They can only be claimed if the player has an "active" {{Item|Jungle Key}}. * They can be claimed once per "active" {{Item|Jungle Key}}. * The loot is entirely rerolled for each player and for each "active" {{Item|Jungle Key}}. In this context, an "Active {{Item|Jungle Key|link=}}" refers to the situation in which the player – {{grey|(A)}} – has given a {{Item|Jungle Key}} to a {{NPCSprite|Kalhuiki Door Guardian}} '''and''' – {{gray|(B)}} – has not claimed the {{Item|Amethyst Crystal}} afterwards. ==Loot== '''Treasure Chests''' roll in a Loot Pool depending on {{green|3}} factors: their {{Blue|Type}} ('''Dug''' or '''Loot''') ; their {{Blue|Tier}} ('''Low''' or '''High''') ; their {{Blue|Location}} ({{Zone|Jungle}}, {{Zone|Goblin Holdout}}, {{Zone|Mithril Deposits}}, {{Zone|Precursor Remnants}}, {{Zone|Magma Fields}}, {{Zone|Fairy Grotto}} – otherwise, a generic one is assigned). These amount to a total of {{green|28}} different Loot Pools. '''Treasure Chests''''s loot can be affected by modifiers. ===Tier=== Treasure Chests are '''tiered''': '''High''' or '''Low'''. {{Blue|High Tier}} Treasure Chests will roll in their appropriate {{blue|High Tier}} Loot Pool. {{Blue|Low Tier}} ones will roll in their appropriate {{blue|Low Tier}} Loot Pool. * '''Dug Chests''' have a {{green|5%}} chance to be of High tier. Otherwise, they are of low tier. * '''Loot Chests''''s tiers are set on prefabrication. In other words, they are generated along the structure they spawn in. ===Rolls=== By default, each '''Treasure Chest''' rolls {{green|3}}-{{green|6}} times in its appropriate {{Blue|Loot Pool}}, averaging to {{green|4.5}} rolls. This can be increased to a maximum average of {{green|5.15}} rolls by the following sources: {|class="wikitable" !{\color{green}x} chance for {{green|+1}} Roll !Type of Source !Source !Condition |- |class="ct"|{{green|+5.0%}}→{{green|50%}} |[[Attribute]] |{{Attr|Bigger Box}} ({{Item|Hideoncave Shard}}) |{{bc}} |- |class="ct"|{{green|+0.1%}}→{{green|10%}} |[[Attribute]] |{{Attr|Echo of Boxes}} ({{Item|Cuboa Shard}}) cascading on the above. |{{bc}} |- |class="ct"|{{green|+0.05%}}→{{green|5%}} |[[Attribute]] |{{Attr|Echo of Echoes}} ({{Item|Tiamat Shard}}) cascading on the 2 above. |{{bc}} |} ===Loot Modifiers=== By default, the amount of loot granted by a roll is {{green|1.0x}}. This can be increased by the following sources: {|class="wikitable !Loot Multiplier !Type of Source !Source !Condition |- |class="ct"|{{green|10%}} chance for {{green|+1.0×}} |[[Attribute]] |{{Attr|Crystal Serendipity}} ({{Item|Silentdepth Shard}}) |{{bc}} |- |class="ct"|{{green|+1%}} → {{green|+50%}} |{{HotM|small=y}} perk |[[Heart of the Mountain#Powder Buff|{{AN|Powder Buff}}]] |{{Gemstone Powder}} |- |class="ct"|{{green|+5%}} |[[Drill]] |{{Item|Ruby Drill TX-15}} |{{Gemstone Powder}} |- |class="ct"|{{green|+10%}} |[[Drill]] |{{Item|Gemstone Drill LT-522}} |{{Gemstone Powder}} |- |class="ct"|{{green|+15%}} |[[Drill]] |{{Item|Topaz Drill KGR-12}} |{{Gemstone Powder}} |- |class="ct"|{{green|+20%}} |[[Drill]] |{{Item|Jasper Drill X}} |{{Gemstone Powder}} |- |class="ct"|{{green|+1%}}{{ConfirmationNeeded}} |[[Drill Part]] |{{Item|Blue Cheese Goblin Omelette}} cascading onto the [[Heart of the Mountain#Powder Buff|{{AN|Powder Buff}}]] perk |{{Gemstone Powder}} |- |class="ct"|{{green|+0.2%}} → {{green|20%}} {{ConfirmationNeeded}} |[[Pet]] perk |{{Item|Scatha Pet|rarity=legendary}}'s {{AN|Bejeweled Eyes}} perk |{{Gemstone Powder}} |- |class="ct"|{{green|+5%}} → {{green|50%}} chance |[[Pet]] perk |{{Item|Goblin Pet|rarity=legendary}}'s {{AN|Free-range Eggs}} perk |"Rare" [[Goblin Egg]]s. |} === Dug Chests Loot Pools === {{Tabview |-|/Jungle Loot|Jungle |-|/Goblin Holdout Loot|Goblin Holdout |-|/Mithril Deposits Loot|Mithril Deposits |-|/Precursor Remnants Loot|Precursor Remnants |-|/Magma Fields Loot|Magma Fields |-|/Fairy Grotto Loot|Fairy Grotto |-|/Crystal Hollows Loot|Crystal Hollows }} === Loot Chests Loot Pools === {{MoreInfoNeeded|Lf Loot Tables}} == Game Messages == * {{Attr|Crystal Serendipity}} attribute activating: {{Dialogue|&a&lSERENDIPITOUS! == Trivia ==

* '''Yog Armor''' and {{Item|Sorrow Armor}} are the only armor sets that have Universal Gemstone Slots.
*'''Yog Armor''', {{Item|Sorrow Armor}} and {{Item|Armor of Divan}} are the only armor sets that can store {{Item|Topaz}} Gemstones.
*Maxed '''Yog Armor''' grants {{Stat|ms|+1420}}, which is {{Stat|ms|60}} more than maxed {{Item|Armor of Divan}}.
* Placing a {{Item|Ruby}} in {{Item|Flamebreaker Armor}} and upgrading it into '''Yog Armor''' will cause the {{Item|Ruby}} to stop granting {{Stat|hp}}. It will be available for refund at the {{Item|Gemstone Grinder}}: additionally, the following text will display in the tooltip.

The '''Murder House''' is a sub-location of the {{zone|Village Plaza}} in the [[Rift Dimension]].

== Purpose ==
=== Reverse-Murder Investigation ===
{{Main|Detective Amog}}
The reverse-murder investigation begins in the '''Murder House'''. [[Detective Amog]] appears standing in the center of the room and offers the player a {{Item|Detective Scanner}}. Once all necessary objects have been scanned, {{NPCSprite|Detective Amog}} will move around the [[Rift]], and the player must talk to certain [[NPC]]s to progress.

After talking to the [[Blacksmith (Rift)|Blacksmith]], the player will need to return to the '''Murder House''' and scan the painting. After doings so, the quest will move to {{zone|Taylor's}} and back to the house, where [[Ramero]] will appear, barricaded in. After breaking the barricade by calling for [[Wizardman]], the player must kill them with a {{Item|Tactician's Murder Weapon}}, and as a reward, will receive a {{Item|Ring of Broken Love}}.

=== Second Reverse-Murder Investigation ===
The second reverse-murder investigation begins in the '''Mountaintop'''. [[Detective Amog]] will direct the player through the original quest as the player becomes increasingly exasperated: after which, the player must barricade the '''Murder House''' and wait for Wizardman to break the barricade, then kill their past self in order to same Romero.

As a reward, the player receives a {{Item|Ring of Eternal Love}}.

The '''Rift Dimension''' is a location accessible through the {{Zone|Wizard Tower}}, unlocked upon reaching {{SkyBlock Level|12}}. By acquiring a [[Wizard|Dimensional Infusion]], players can enter the Rift Dimension and progress through it, securing [[Rift Timecharms]] in the {{Zone|Rift Gallery}} and progressing through the [[Rift Guide]].

== Dimensional Infusion ==
The '''Rift''' can be accessed by entering the [[Wizard Tower#Wizard Portal|Wizard Portal]] in the [[Wilderness|Wilderness]] by the mountain.

Players gain a free {{Pink|Dimensional Infusion}} every {{Green|4}} hours. Up to {{Green|3}} free {{Pink|Dimensional Infusions}} can be stored and used later.

Additionally, there are 4 more ways for a player to obtain a {{Pink|Dimensional Infusion}} which is needed to enter the Rift:
*Paying {{NPCSprite|Wizard}} {{Item|Grand Experience Bottle|amount=32}}s.
*Paying {{NPCSprite|Wizard}} {{Bits|200}}.  They can also toggle {{Green|Auto-Buy}}, which automatically purchases {{Pink|Dimensional Infusion}}, but does not keep them in the '''Rift''' once their time runs out.
*Having a {{Item|Rift Prism}} in their inventory or [[Accessory Bag]], or imbued through {{NPCSprite|Erihann}}.
*Accepting the {{NPCSprite|Tal Ker}} [[Visitor]] offer in {{Zone|Garden}}.
A {{Pink|Dimensional Infusion}} is not consumed upon entering the Rift, and is only consumed upon leaving the {{Zone|Wizard Tower (Rift)}}. However, if a player joins the Rift {{Green|3}} times using the same {{Pink|Dimensional Infusion}} it will be finally be consumed with the following message:

It determines the amount of time the player can spend in the [[Rift|Rift Dimension]] before being sent back to the {{Zone|Wizard Tower}} in the [[Hub]]. == Mechanics == The player has a base {{stat|Rift Time}} of {{Green|8:00}}. Each {{stat|rt}} the player has is equivalent to each second the player has left in the [[Rift|Rift Dimension]]. While the player is in the {{Zone|Wizard Tower (Rift)}}, {{Zone|Rift Gallery}}, or {{Zone|Mirrorverse}}, their {{Statname|Rift Time}} does not deplete. When in or near the [[Colosseum (Rift)|Colosseum]], it depletes two times slower, and when in the [[Time Chamber]], it depletes two times faster. == Usage ==
The {{Item|Rusty Spoon}} allowed the player to assist in breaking the {{zone|Prison of the Bereft}} added by {{NPCSprite|Candidate Aura;Aura}}.

The '''Rusty Spoon''' has two custom [[Stats]], {{Red|+1% Tetanus Chance}} and {{Green|+2 Determination}}. {{Red|Tetanus Chance}} grants a chance for the player to lose {{Stat|hp|70}} when hitting {{zone|Prison of the Bereft}}. Additionally, losing health granted the following message in chat:

There is an {{Chance|80%|4|5}} chance for the spawned mob to be a {{MobSprite|Stoneworm}}, and a {{Chance|20%|1|5}} chance for a '''Scatha''' to spawn. There is a {{Green|30s}} cooldown after a '''Scatha''' or {{MobSprite|Stoneworm}} spawns.

Chance to spawn {{MobSprite|Stoneworm}}s can be increased with {{Reforge|Blazing}} reforge, [[Heart of the Mountain#Tunnel Vision|Tunnel Vision HotM]] perk and [[Marigold#Treasure of the Earth|Treasure of the Earth Gold Essence Shop]] perk. Chance to replace {{MobSprite|Stoneworm}}s with {{MobSprite|Scatha}}s can be increased with {{stat|tracking}}.

The {{Item|Armadillo Pet}} and {{AN|Mole}} perk do not prevent spawning by themselves, however the conditions mentioned above must still be met.

After digging out a suitable tunnel, breaking the blocks at the player's eye level on the side can still trigger '''Scathas''' spawning. Breaking the blocks below foot level will also spawn '''Scathas'''.

While spawning, '''Scathas''' make a unique squelching sound {{Green|3}} times, alerting players of their presence. Additionally, the following message appears in chat:

blocks.condition_context_raw: s increased by {{Stat|scc}}, which starts at {{Staticon|scc|20}}. == Mechanics == '''Sea Creatures''' are mobs which can be caught while fishing. The type of Sea Creature which is caught depends on the player's {{Skill|Fishing}} level, the bobber location and fishing medium ({{Item|Water}} or {{Item|Lava}}). When killed, they drop loot and {{Skill|Fishing}} XP. * The list of all Sea Creatures, their requirements to be caught and drops can be seen in the in-game Sea Creature Guide through the Fishing Skill menu or the /scg command. * The chance in percentage to catch a Sea Creature is determined by the player's {{Stat|scc}}. The chance of catching a Sea Creature is reduced on {{Zone|Private Island}} and {{Zone|The Garden}} though this change is not reflected in the [[Stats]] menu. * Sea Creatures cannot be damaged by arrows, except those shot from the {{Item|Prismarine Bow}}. They take {{green|2x}} damage from [[Fishing Rods]]. *There is a Sea Creature cap of {{green|60}} per server ({{green|30}} on {{Zone|Galatea}}{{Confirm}}). After this cap is reached, players will only be able to catch {{cyan|fish}} and {{gold|treasure}}, even with {{stat|scc|100}}, until some Sea Creatures are killed or despawn. Furthermore, there is a per-player Sea Creature cap of {{green|10}} on all islands. ** If a player already has {{green|9}} Sea Creatures out and catches two at once due to {{Stat|Double Hook}}, this cap can be exceeded, making the theoretical maximum per player {{green|11}} Sea Creatures. However, {{MobSprite|Magma Slug;Magma Slugs}} and {{MobSprite|Water Hydra;Water Hydras}} are an exception. Despite being split up to multiple entities, it still only counts as {{green|one}} towards the cap. ** Upon reaching the cap, players will receive the following message:

Once an area has been opened by a player, it will be accessible by the rest of the server for 30 seconds, after which the wall will close again. Once closed, if the player is inside, the only way to get out is to warp to the [[Private Island]] (or another island if the player has the [[Travel Scrolls|Travel Scroll]]), use another Superboom TNT (or wait for someone else to use one), or use a {{Item|Horse Pet}} to glitch out.

=== Crystal Hollows ===
Inside the [[Crystal Hollows]], '''Superboom TNT''' can be used to blow up the two tombs in one of {{MobSprite|Boss Corleone}} spawning rooms, it will reveal a chest and spawn a {{MobSprite|Crypt Undead}}.

=== Dungeons ===
Inside [[Dungeons]], '''Superboom TNT''' can be used to blow up tombs. Different mobs can spawn from different tombs:

*{{MobSprite|Crypt Undead}} (from normal tombs in almost every room)
*{{MobSprite|King Midas}} (from golden tombs)
*{{MobSprite|Prince}} (from hidden or special tomb)
*Admin skinned Crypt Undead (from tombs inside the Admin Room)
*{{MobSprite|Deathmite}} (from tomb in lava in a unique room, there is a sign above it that reads "Here Lies an Ancient Evil")

Superboom TNT can also be used to blow up cracked walls, usually hiding secrets.

The [[Archer]]'s {{AN|Explosive Shot}} class ability, the [[Mage]]'s {{AN|Guided Sheep}} class ability and the {{Item|Conjuring}}'s  ability can alternatively be used to blow up anything Superboom TNT can.

== Lore ==
*Before becoming '''The Watcher''', he was a human known as Lathrop, he was a pupil and adopted son of {{NPCSprite|Dr. Emmett}} after his parents died during the [[Calamity]]. Ever since [[The Breach|{{purple|The Breach}}]] on top of the mountain has opened, Lathrop started getting visions of a floating eye. 
*One day he is asked by Dr. Emmett to deliver a letter to his colleague in {{zone|Wilderness}}. He heads out and for some reason feels sad looking at the house he lived in. Entering the Inn, he was getting the feeling of Deja Vu. In [[Wilderness#Tavern|the Inn]] he saw a man with black hair in black clothing. He recognized this from one of his visions. The mysterious man then leaves upstairs, a different man, a young assassin named [[Livid]], comes to Lathrop and questions him about the mysterious man, since he claims to have never seen in the Inn before. Lathrop answers Livid's question saying that the mysterious man is a merchant from far away land, not knowing what lead him to say that since he in fact didn't know him. Livid then leaves back to his table and Lathrop too goes upstairs.
* A while after, the mysterious man then left the Inn carrying Livid with him. Lathrop decides to follow him, as his feeling of Deja Vu grows stronger, despite him not remembering this. [[Necron]] figures out he is being followed and before the wooden entrance to [[The Catacombs|{{red|The Catacombs}}]] he asks his pursuer, why is he following him. Lathrop explains his situation with visions and Deja Vu, then explains that he saw that by following Necron to [[Kaeman|his master]], he will reach his full potential, as the door opened on their own, Necron urged Lathrop to follow him. 
*In Catacombs he meets The Wither King who leads him to his laboratory, in front of the '''Seeing-Stone''', which immediately triggers a vision in him, he sees a house with <abbr title="Kaeman's late wife, Sarah">a woman</abbr> and <abbr title="Kaeman's deceased daughter, Mylah">a child</abbr> inside, he recognizes the source of the command, Kaeman. The Wither King was impressed by Lathrop's natural abilities and in the following months, he made him use the Seeing-Stone again and again. Which transformed him to the limbless, one-eyed creature he now is. 
*Some time after, he was tasked to see Kaeman's past and use the orb to create a world, identical to the one Kaeman once knew, in which he could once again be happy. He has succeeded. Kaeman thanked the Watcher, which was a rare display from him and told him to be loyal to his new master - Necron, while he decided to stay in an enclosed chamber, dreaming of a happier time. 
*After the seclusion of their master, Necron decided to gather an army of necromancers for his goal and Watcher at some point wrote most of the [[Dungeon Journals]]. In [[Time Systems#AE|1531 AE]], he watches the expedition to the Catacombs. He notices one particular member and his potential in necromancy, after learning his name, The Watcher decided to recruit [[Sadan]].

== Bugs ==
*Flamer can deal damage to everyone in this server instead of an area around it.

== Trivia ==
* In [[Journal#The_Eye|Journal - The Eye]], it is shown that The Watcher was related to [[Sadan]]'s interest in Necromancy.
* The Watcher's eye resembles the Demon Eye from Terraria. This is further supported by the fact that both have a chance to drop item called "Optical Lens" upon their defeat.
*The Watcher fight could be inspired by the first phase of the [[terraria:Brain of Cthulhu|Brain of Cthulhu]] fight in Terraria, where it becomes invincible and it summons minions you must kill.
* The Watcher will revive a player when their Wandering Soul was killed. If Wandering Soul is killed after the respective player was revived in an another way, the killing of a Wandering Soul won't have any effect.
*The color of The Watcher's eye starts changing from a vivid green to a sickly yellow the deeper you go in the Catacombs, which slowly turns more orange when going into [[Catacombs|Master Mode]].
* The Watcher is around a decade older than [[Necron]] according to [[Journal#The_Follower|Journal - The Follower]] and [[Journal#The_Apprentice|Journal - The Apprentice]], as Lathrop was born before the [[Jythar|Calamity]], while Necron was born shortly before the Wither King's attack.
* [[Necron]] has a connection to The Watcher, calling it 'The Eye' by mentioning it in his first welcome speech.
* It is implied that '''The Watcher''' cannot be killed.
* One unknown undead refers to '''The Watcher''' as "Stalker" in [[Journal#Aftermath|Journal - Aftermath]].
** "Stalker" is also '''The Watcher'''<nowiki />'s epitaph in {{NPCSprite|Mort}}'s description of the Entrance floor.
* '''The Watcher'''{{'}}s original name, Lathrop, is a reference to Dr. Emmett Lathrop Brown, more commonly known as Doc, from ''Back to the Future'', as is his father figure, [[Dr. Emmett]].
* Previously, if players managed to enter the Blood Room without picking up the Blood Key, '''The Watcher''' would start spawning mobs anyway. As of [[Changelog/2026/May 11|May 11, 2026]], known methods to achieve this without cheats have been patched, and if a player enters the Blood Room without the Blood Key being picked up first, the run is immediately failed with the following message:

The '''Trial Grounds''' are a sub-location of {{Zone|The Mountaintop}}. It can be entered by challenging {{NPCSprite|Wizardman}} to the '''Temporal Race'''.

== Features ==
The '''Trial Grounds''' features several floating islands that serve as platforms in the race. During the race, some of the islands will fall, failing the race: occasionally, you can click on floating entities labeled {{Blue|REWIND}} to send {{NPCSprite|Wizardman}} a few seconds back in time.

'''Yog Armor'''{{'}}s {{AN|Absorb}} full set bonus grants the player {{Stat|ms|+1}} for every {{Green|5}} {{MobSprite|Yog}}s killed in the [[Bestiary]], up to {{Stat|ms|+500}} at {{Green|2,500}} {{MobSprite|Yog}}s killed.

== Skins ==
{{Item Skins|Yog Helmet}}

== Trivia ==
* '''Yog Armor''' is referred to as '''Armor of Yog''' in the [[Museum]].
* The {{AN|Absorb}} full set bonus used to be stored on the '''Yog Chestplate''' This meant that if a '''Yog Chestplate''' was traded or auctioned, the bonus would transfer over.
* '''Yog Armor''' and {{Item|Sorrow Armor}} are the only armor sets that have Universal Gemstone Slots.
*'''Yog Armor''', {{Item|Sorrow Armor}} and {{Item|Armor of Divan}} are the only armor sets that can store {{Item|Topaz}} Gemstones.
*Maxed '''Yog Armor''' grants {{Stat|ms|+1420}}, which is {{Stat|ms|60}} more than maxed {{Item|Armor of Divan}}.
* Placing a {{Item|Ruby}} in {{Item|Flamebreaker Armor}} and upgrading it into '''Yog Armor''' will cause the {{Item|Ruby}} to stop granting {{Stat|hp}}. It will be available for refund at the {{Item|Gemstone Grinder}}: additionally, the following text will display in the tooltip.
